newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen falling on December jobs data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen falling on December jobs data.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to tumble at Friday's opening on stronger-than-expected jobs data that fueled fears of higher inflation and interest rates.
Government figures showed the United States added 262,000 new jobs in December, far above the consensus estimate of 192,000.The unemmployment rate was unchanged at 5.3 percent.
Bonds fell on the news, with the U.S. Treasury 30-year bond down 1-16/32 to yield 6.87. The Standard & Poors 500 futures index was off 9.85 to 749.05.
